native.requires: Accepted migrated adlx_main for shared native voice operations, audio state and projection.

purpose: Execute the effects ADLX interpreter, including wait exits, physical voice mapping, Q8 timing, channel-nine owner alias and ordered OPL writes. Preserve C stop/restoration/allocation as an explicit synchronous boundary.

inputs: Shared AudioState and a borrowed AudioChannel from effect8..11, independently of raw current_channel/stop identity; operation, fetched code, twelve stable operands and separate fetch cursor.
outputs: Updated borrowed state and cursor; ordered OPL register/value writes; WAIT/END/CONTINUE/divide-fault status; optional TIMER or C stop request.
effects: Wait stores deadline and cursor index only. END repeats cursor only or decrements repeat and issues stop. No main-origin/deadline rebasing.
Instrument physical9 stamps displaced[0].owner and advances11, with no loader/register writes.
Bridge publishes state before C stop; no cached state is published after C returns.
preconditions: Serialized ordinary RAM; no instruction-level IRQ/store observers; no source/destination alias for native instrument copy.
Native selected record is aligned within effect8..11; malformed selectors use literal fallback.
Canonical16-entry dispatch table for native fetch; changed tables use literal fallback.
A finite burst or bridge1000000-event budget. No claim that arbitrary malformed no-wait streams terminate.
Fetch cursor is a separate object; it must not alias the shared state. Canonical disjoint machine stack and SOUND frame for bridge proofs/tests.

callers: TickAdlxPlayback visits all four effect records when reserved&15 and byte(control)&5==5, using unsigned deadline comparison. It preserves ES/DI/BX around the interpreter and AX/BX/DX across the callback. Direct handler entries retain already-fetched-opcode ABI.

callees.native: audio_main_step for accepted voice operations. Effects frequency/key use live voices with reservation routing temporarily disabled/restored; gain/instrument retain driver gates.
callees.external: TIMER:SetTimerCallbackInterval remains a synchronous dispatch service; timer.json owns its admitted native scheduler semantics. Ordered port delivery remains a platform service. Their real ordered hardware effects run through the bridge in compiled integration/corpus/host checks.

indirect: Canonical16-entry table has long wait/frequency/key-off/gain/instrument/no-op/period/control and eight short-wait entries. Only TIMER interval and C stop external targets. Modified tables and unknown record aliases use explicit audited literal fallback.

memory.owner: Common C/SOUND owner in accepted native/audio.h; additive effect-slot constants only, unchanged types and layout. Header/projection remain owned by adlx_main certificate.
memory.channels: Selected record8..11,42-byte physical stride from0014. Native start/cursor borrowed resource references, repeat+04, cursor+10, deadline+1E, first physical voice+24, Q8 step+26, control+28. current_channel is a separate raw allocation/stop identity.
memory.voices: Live0278 and displaced032C,20-byte strides. Physical instrument channel9 owner store0278+9*20+16=033C is displaced[0].owner, never a tenth independent voice.
memory.other: Shared playing/period/handle/current slot/reserved/operator lookup and all clock/fade/section state retained. Interpreter does not allocate, scan, fade, mix samples or program DMA. C stop may mutate multiple descriptors/voice allocation and raw current slot; bridge does not overwrite those changes.

assumptions: No Boolean/capacity/reachable-state restrictions on native values; invalid channels and byte wrap remain admitted.
Input and sound state are disjoint ordinary memory for native instrument path; sequential self-overlap runs literal path.
TIMER and STOP are capability boundaries; logical native proof ends at requests. Real C post-state and ordered writes are differentially compared.
CPU busy-loop cycle duration is outside deterministic observation; its product/flag contract retained.
Full stream composition is finite corpus C, separate from any symbolic one-step proof.
eliminated: Register/segment/stack notation from ordinary native effects code; retained only in bridge.
Recursive machine table tail dispatch replaced by ordinary typed step and iterative bridge fetch.
Hardware writes replaced by ordered native events delivered through platform_out.
retained: 1n/2n require<9;3n consumes one even when invalid;4n accepts<=9, stamps owner before loader rejects9, consumes11.

Short wait uses code&127 and unsigned word Q8.
